codeReview.summary: The k8s-client-setup feature correctly implements Kubernetes client setup for Job management with client configuration (in-cluster or kubeconfig), namespace targeting (llm-eval), label selector helpers, and owner reference setup. All 32 unit tests pass. Code follows project conventions from AGENTS.md. A minor code quality issue exists in the config fallback logic (duplicate rest.InClusterConfig() call).

issues.description: Redundant rest.InClusterConfig() call in fallback section. After the first InClusterConfig() fails and falls back, the second InClusterConfig() call at line 80 has identical logic and will also fail with the same error. This should be a loadKubeconfig() call instead.
The fallback logic for kubeconfig could be clearer - instead of calling rest.InClusterConfig() twice, it should fall back to default kubeconfig via loadKubeconfig("", "").
